remarks: Set on a quiet street in Tustin, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home with a 2-car garage is move-in ready, with fresh interior paint and brand-new carpet throughout. The main level features a spacious, functional layout with a living room, kitchen, dining area, family room, and a convenient 3/4 bath. Upstairs, three well-sized bedrooms offer plenty of room for everyone. An open kitchen makes everyday living and entertaining easy, while laminate wood flooring in part of the main level and updated windows add lasting value.
